Pitched Roofs and Re-Roofs

Natural and man-made slate and tiled roofs, installed and replaced across Lancashire and the Fylde coast. A pitched roof usually takes us 3 to 5 days.

How We Do Pitched Roofs

We install and replace natural and man-made slate roofs, and tiled roofs in a wide variety of styles, colours and finishes. When repairs stop being worth paying for, we strip the old roof and replace it.

Repair or Replace?

Slipped tiles, storm damage and the odd leak can usually be repaired. We replace the damaged tiles, repair the flashing and seal the leak. When repairs are no longer cost-effective, a full replacement gives you a new weatherproof roof in a material that suits the house, whether that's natural slate, man-made slate or tiles in a style and colour to match.

Chimneys

If the chimney needs attention we can do that too: repointing, leadwork, flashing repairs and rebuilds.

Signs a Pitched Roof Needs Work

  • Tiles or slates that keep slipping or cracking
  • Daylight showing through the roof timbers in the loft
  • A ridge or roof line that has started to sag
  • Repair bills that keep coming back

How Long It Takes

A pitched roof usually takes us 3 to 5 days.
